description: This PHP source file defines the `FirehoseClient` class within the `Aws irehose` namespace, used for interacting with the Amazon Kinesis Firehose service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, describing, and listing delivery streams, as well as managing encryption, tags, and data records.

classes.name: FirehoseClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with Amazon Kinesis Firehose, extending from AwsClient.

methods.name: createDeliveryStream
methods.description: Creates a new delivery stream in Kinesis Firehose.

methods.name: describeDeliveryStream
methods.description: Provides details about a specified delivery stream.

methods.name: listTagsForDeliveryStream
methods.description: Lists tags for a specified delivery stream.

methods.name: putRecord
methods.description: Writes a single data record into a delivery stream.

methods.name: putRecordBatch
methods.description: Writes multiple data records into a delivery stream in a single call.

methods.name: startDeliveryStreamEncryption
methods.description: Enables server-side encryption for a delivery stream.

methods.name: tagDeliveryStream
methods.description: Adds or updates tags for a delivery stream.

methods.name: untagDeliveryStream
methods.description: Removes tags from a delivery stream.

methods.name: updateDestination
methods.description: Updates the destination of a delivery stream.
